correctness.rationale: Exchangeability reduces covariance with the pair-collision U-statistic to covariance with one selected collision indicator. Conditioning on the collision category gives the stated exact formula \(2s_2A_n-(1+s_2)B_n\). Under the size-biased category variable \(P\), \(A_n=E f(P)\) and \(B_n=E[P f(P)]\) with \(f(x)=(1-x)^{n-2}\) antitone. The two-copy covariance identity therefore gives \(B_n\le s_2A_n\), yielding the positive lower bound. For \(n>2\), strict monotonicity of \(f\) gives equality exactly for a constant size-biased mass, hence a uniform parent law; for \(n=2\), equality is automatic. The exact-rational verifier exhausts several complete sample spaces and independently matches the formula.
